title: The Blue Moon Won't Get You Hired. These LinkedIn & Google Hacks Just Might.
description:
With tonight's Blue Moon, a lot of people are talking about new opportunities, career changes, and fresh starts. While I can't promise the stars will help your job search, I can share the strategies that actually work.

In this video, I break down Google search hacks, Boolean search techniques, LinkedIn strategies, and recruiter-finding shortcuts that help you uncover opportunities most job seekers never see.

These are practical tactics I've used for 20 years helping job seekers navigate hidden jobs, ghost postings, and hiring processes that aren't always obvious from the outside.

 Watch until the end for my favorite Google trick that helps you identify the decision-makers at a company—even when LinkedIn hides them behind premium filters.

You'll learn:

• How to use Boolean search to find real, active job postings
• LinkedIn hacks to uncover recruiters who hire in your field
• How OR searches instantly expand job results
• How to use alumni searches strategically
• A one-click company research hack that helps you stand out in interviews

 Whether you're counting on the Blue Moon or not, these strategies can help you find your next opportunity faster.

If you need more support creating a resume that gets picked, check out my Get Seen Guide below:
